description: This file defines the 'Channel' class within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace, implementing WebSocket link handling, JSON message packaging, serialization/deserialization, and WebSocket communication management. It includes nested classes for managing message packages, serialization, and deserialization, and virtual methods for handling WebSocket requests and responses.

classes.name: Channel
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket channel handling communication, message packaging, serialization, deserialization, and state management within the plugin framework.

classes.name: Channel::Package
classes.description: Manages message payloads which can be either JSON objects or text strings, with proper resource cleanup.

classes.name: Channel::SerializerImpl
classes.description: Handles serialization of JSON elements for outbound messages.

classes.name: Channel::DeserializerImpl
classes.description: Handles deserialization of incoming data streams into JSON objects.
